offering_description.value: Provides temperature-sensitive truckload transportation of refrigerated food and other goods for shippers across the US and parts of Canada and Mexico. Operates its own fleet of refrigerated tractors and trailers, plus intermodal and brokerage services.

primary_services.value: temperature-controlled truckload freight; dedicated fleet transportation; intermodal rail transport; freight brokerage; cross-border freight to Canada and Mexico

customer_segment.value: B2B: food and consumer goods manufacturers, grocers, retailers and other shippers of temperature-sensitive freight

end_markets.value: food and beverage; grocery and retail; consumer packaged goods; healthcare and perishable goods

revenue_model.value: service fees: per-mile and per-load freight charges, fuel surcharges and accessorial fees; project or contract: dedicated fleet contracts with shippers

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs refrigerated tractors and trailers hauling shippers' freight; service provider: intermodal and brokerage arranging third-party capacity for shippers

geography_served.value: North America: United States, with cross-border service to Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: truckload, dedicated, intermodal and brokerage services, all temperature-controlled

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales staff contracting directly with shippers; agents / brokers: freight brokers and third-party logistics intermediaries

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: motor carrier safety, hours-of-service, emissions and food transport rules from DOT, FMCSA, EPA and FDA

divestiture_lines: P2.40: MARTEN TRANSPORT ANNOUNCES SALE OF ASSETS RELATED TO INTERMODAL BUSINESS
